Overview

Wuhan is a city in Hubei with a population of 12,327,000. A major transportation hub in central China, known for its Yangtze River crossings, university district, and emerging semiconductor industry. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
